title: Flow Selection Live Preview
description: Fix flow area-select so preselected nodes and marquee overlay are live-previewed during drag (dag paint chrome + label overlay).
summary: Area-select marquee now live-previews selection: DagHost paint resolves preselect/preselect_removed into selected/highlighted chrome for nodes, handles, and edges during drag; flow label overlay uses the same chrome mapping via flowElementInteractionChrome. Added regression tests in dag and flow/react.
